scope: Synthetic research only; not business approval, customer validation or production authorization
relationship_to_data_protocol: Separate subsequent modeling specification. Do not alter the historical data-only protocol, its null model fields, or the prepared DEV bytes.

business_rules.pending_balance: Any positive previous balance blocks new credit, including current debt. Only full observed settlement permits evaluation, not automatic approval.
business_rules.target_scope: Outcome of an actually granted synthetic credit, not approval or permanent loss
business_rules.row_scope: Study phase only; warmup supplies history but is excluded from supervised rows
business_rules.source_review_limit: Rildo reviewed 23 intentional V5 sample items and supplied later answers; not all V6 rows and not predictive performance

feature_policy.group_metadata: client_id only for disjoint partitions; replica and Lima civil date only for review capacity
feature_policy.constants_and_duplicates: Retain the eleven-field contract. Report constants and completed_sales == paid_credits; never claim independent importance, add noise, or fabricate cash-sale history.
feature_policy.no_feature_selection: No new variables, removal of constants, or changes in distributions after examining OOF or FINAL

preprocessing_policy: Fresh Pipeline per training fold for every family including Dummy; SVM calibration wraps that Pipeline. Fit preprocessing only on known-label training rows. Missing targets are never imputed; all-missing training features stop execution.

cv.fallback_policy: Exactly three folds; stop, never reseed
cv.unknown_oof: Assign each unknown study row to its client's held-out outer fold. Fit on known training rows only; score both known and unknown held-out cases. Unknowns compete for daily capacity, but never enter supervised metrics or calibration.
cv.oof_queue_scope: Compute held-out daily queues per outer fold, replica and Lima date; folds have separate models, so do not pretend their capacity competition is one deployable full-cohort queue. Report this limitation.
cv.selection_optimism: OOF is reused for configuration and threshold selection, so winning OOF metrics are optimistic. Inner sigmoid calibration is not nested independent hyperparameter evaluation.
cv.evaluation_scope: Generalization to new synthetic clients in the same simulator, not prospective time validation or real customers

svm_calibration.policy: Use exact saved inner partitions inside each outer training subset, plus saved full-DEV partitions for the final refit. Unknown labels never calibrate. Convergence failure stops without retuning.

baseline_policy: Same rows, partitions, preprocessing and capacity. Report raw predictions separately from threshold-then-cap actions. Dummy constant scores tie by fictional loan_id, not business priority.

review_policy.queue: Threshold first, descending score, then fictional loan_id for ties; at most five per replica and civil date in America/Lima
review_policy.scope: Hypothetical review of granted synthetic credits only, not real authorization, all applications, collections, or mandatory business work
review_policy.single_input_inference: Threshold classification only. A single response does not establish admission to the daily queue.

selection.primary: OOF F2 of held-out capped review actions on known labels, beta=2
tie_breakers: Fewer total review actions including unknowns
Earlier configuration in declared tree-then-SVM grid
selection.rationale: Declared concern about missed delays supports studying recall-weighted F2. Beta=2 and every tie-breaker are team research choices, not measured business error costs.
selection.no_inherited_winner: Neither SVM nor tree is predetermined. V4 and V5 results do not choose the V6 winner, threshold, seed, or grid.
selection.global_winner: Select only between the two U3 model-family winners using the same frozen rules; report both Dummy references regardless of whether ML beats them

reporting.overfit: Compare train and OOF before FINAL; retain regularization/depth/leaf limits. Never promote a model on test metrics.
reporting.interpretation: Saved tree paths in original units, standardized SVM coefficients, and limitations from constant/duplicate features; no causal claims
reporting.errors: At least three deterministic first-by-loan_id misclassifications from cached FINAL predictions, or all if fewer than three; never rerun test to choose explanatory cases
reporting.business_comparison: Report review actions and FN/FP against review-all limited; two-minute time differences are hypothetical, not financial savings or owner-approved utility

freeze_before_final: This protocol and all source/data/code hashes
Exact DEV manifest and saved fold plan
Complete OOF search, including unsuccessful candidates
Family winners and single selected U3 winner with thresholds
Preprocessing and all four refitted trusted model artifacts

success_proposal.technical: Selected ML final policy F2 strictly exceeds both frozen Dummy policy F2 values, with capacity respected
success_proposal.failure: If it does not, report the study as failing this proposal; do not iterate on the test
success_proposal.business: A future authorized real pilot must measure review time and FN/FP consequences against a documented reference. No current savings or acceptable error cost is established.

illustrative_input.policy: Illustrative fictional S/20 request on S/80 cap, no prior outstanding debt; not a real customer or test row. Check distinctness against DEV and FINAL; if duplicate, disclose and omit live inference rather than choose a favorable case.

reproducibility: Fresh outputs only, fixed seeds and declared versions; preserve all original V4/V5/V6 DEV sources. A repeated fixed protocol checks reproducibility, not a second independent validation.
current_action: Freeze protocol and verify inputs only. No V6 fit, final generation, artifact promotion, deployment or production change is performed in this step.
limits: Synthetic histories, 24 DEV example clients and repeated observations, not real validation
Owner review covers an intentional V5 sample, not all V6 rows
75/25 amount mixture, exact payment-time distribution, 20:00 strict cutoff, latent Beta, warmup and stationarity are team assumptions
Finite complete-payment plans do not estimate permanent loss
Only linked credit sales are modeled; cash sales are unmeasured
Granted-only analysis cannot estimate outcomes of rejected applications
Fold-specific OOF queues miss cross-fold capacity competition and are not a deployed full-day queue
Global source coherence, client consent, human review, real costs and public deployment are not certified

revision_overrides.authorized_user_request: que se reetrene y que de los datos finales; me refiero a que sea v6 final
revision_overrides.authorization_scope: New synthetic research execution named V6 Final. Preserve prior V6 as history; no permission for commercial production or real-customer decisions.
revision_overrides.relationship_to_previous_v6: Prospective revision after prior V6 results were consulted. New seeds, clients and eligible-only training/evaluation; no claim that the study design was chosen before seeing earlier results.

policies.initial_loans: Simulated owner-authorized first credits stay in event history, but their evaluations never fit or score the model. Their later observed repayments may supply legitimate paid history.
policies.as_of: Only loans, sales and payments strictly before the application timestamp may affect features; no pending_at_cutoff or future outcomes enter routing.
policies.supervised_population: Granted study loans with confirmed zero prior balance and at least one fully repaid credit. Known outcomes only fit/calibrate/score supervised metrics; eligible unknowns compete only for queue capacity.
policies.refusals: Report pending blocks, owner-review referrals and any other simulator refusals separately. They are not predicted class zero/one, model true positives or evidence of model accuracy.
policies.selection: Retain original 12 tree and 6 SVM configurations, seven thresholds, F2 OOF capped-review primary criterion, tie-breakers and two Dummy baselines. No predetermined winning family or threshold.
policies.fold_feasibility: Exactly three grouped outer and inner folds with both labels in every subset; otherwise preserve failure and stop without another seed.
policies.final: Generate only after selection, model artifacts and hash freeze. One batch per frozen model on eligible FINAL cases. Never retune from this test; retain poor results or class-adequacy deviations.
policies.capacity: Five alerts/day and two minutes/case remain unmeasured hypotheses. Mandatory owner reviews are reported separately, not treated as capacity-free or included in the model-alert queue.
policies.generator: Unchanged frozen V6 simulator and assumptions; do not alter latent distributions, 75/25 amount mix, payment windows, warmup or approvals to improve metrics.
policies.reporting: Metrics are conditional on model eligibility in fresh synthetic clients, not all applications, real customers, commercial benefit or prospective calendar-time validation. Earlier V6 results are historical and not directly interchangeable.

revision_overrides.execution_policy: Freeze runner/helper/policy/runtime/source hashes before DEV generation. Keep original V6 directories untouched. A repeat of these fixed seeds checks reproducibility only, not an independent second validation.
revision_overrides.human_status: PENDIENTE: review by four team members, rehearsal and academic submission; owner review is conditional, not predictive model approval
